sinopsis.es: La autobiografía de Koki, un loro inmortal, que retrata la vida de este animal único, fiel compañero del mariscal Tito, líder de Yugoslavia durante 35 años. Un rico archivo fotográfico revive los recuerdos enjaulados de esta cacatúa, que tuvo el honor de conocer a estrellas de Hollywood y a dictadores sedientos de sangre. (GIFF)
sinopsis.en: The autobiography of Koki, an immortal parrot. Artist Quenton Miller portrays the life of this unique animal, a loyal comrade of Marshal Tito, leader of Yugoslavia for 35 years. A rich photographic archive relives the caged memories of this cockatoo, who had the honour of meeting Hollywood stars, and bloodthirsty dictators. A funny portrait, non-aligned with the documentary orthodoxy, that deals with the false constructions of history.
